claims.observable_claim: Without a valid projection the Job Passport panel is absent.
A valid projection renders the Work Request, canonical state version, and current observed state.
Each declared status has a text label and never relies on color or motion alone.
A component control opens evidence and checkpoint detail using keyboard-operable native controls.
Persistent profile and actual surface/model/harness are visibly separate.
Declared coverage, observation fidelity, uncertainty, and deviation candidates remain distinct.
The observed timeline presents sequence, declared step, observed movement, and retention without transcript text.
Evidence detail says whether independent verification permits a verified-checkpoint handoff.
Important meaning survives keyboard use, reduced motion, and narrow width.
Stale, malformed, or conflicting receipts cannot silently overwrite newer canonical state.
Claude, Codex, Hermes, and Grok native transport payloads retain comparable visual staffing shape.
Interrupted and resumed attempts stay distinct from verified completion and preserve checkpoint-only handoff.
